items.testExpectation: Inventory a dependency-specific upstream/spec denominator per algorithm, require mapped lane fixtures and official vectors, record PHP pass/fail evidence, include large/streaming/chunked and malformed/truncated payload cases, preserve compatibility quirks, mark security limitations, and give no progress credit for shelling out to external hash tools.
items.reuseNotes: Consolidates duplicate hashing from rclone, Gitoxide, Dolt, Quadrable, Syncthing, and markerPDF benchmark/archive evidence.
items.blocker: none

items.name: SQL and storage codec core
items.source: Dolt SQL/prolly storage evidence in lanes/dolt/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json, SQLite file-format evidence in lanes/libsqlite/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json, and Quadrable key/varint/store evidence in lanes/quadrable/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json
items.essentialCapability: Provides bounded row, value, key, and chunk codecs needed for native SQL-data versioning, SQLite-file compatibility, and proofable key/value storage without delegating to external database engines.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: SQL scalar value encodings, NULL/blob/text/number boundaries, row/cell framing, varint/key codecs, fixture-backed collation identifiers, Prolly/Noms-style chunk metadata where mapped, SQLite record/page payload handoff, and portable dump/restore codecs. Out of scope: full SQL optimizers, MySQL server compatibility, LMDB engine porting, query planners, network servers, cloud databases, and shelling out to sqlite3/dolt/mysql tools.
items.testExpectation: Require a SQL/storage-codec-specific upstream/spec denominator with mapped Dolt, libsqlite, and Quadrable fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, row/chunk/page/key/value parity, malformed/corrupt/truncated storage cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to sqlite3, dolt, mysql, LMDB tools, or external database servers.
items.reuseNotes: Share varint, key ordering, binary-safe string, checksum, and charset helpers across Dolt storage slices, libsqlite records/pages, and Quadrable proof/dump codecs.
items.blocker: Activate only when Dolt, libsqlite, or Quadrable storage work needs a shared codec boundary rather than lane-local row/page/proof slices.

items.name: SQL expression and scalar semantics core
items.source: Dolt query-diff scalar/function evidence, go-mysql-server focused selectors, SQLite expression/JSON/date evidence, and libsqlite native execution needs recorded in lane manifests
items.essentialCapability: Provides shared native SQL expression parsing/evaluation behavior for query-diff reviews, SQLite-compatible JSON/date/scalar functions, WordPress database migration checks, and future bounded SQL execution without delegating to external database engines.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: fixture-backed expression parsing, NULL and three-valued logic, scalar function dispatch, comparison/collation hooks, numeric/string/date/JSON operator semantics, deterministic diagnostics, and safe literal/value coercion. Out of scope: full SQL optimizers, query planners, transaction engines, MySQL or SQLite server processes, network protocols, stored procedure runtimes, live databases, and shelling out to sqlite3/dolt/mysql.
items.testExpectation: Require a SQL-expression-specific upstream/spec denominator with mapped Dolt/go-mysql-server scalar selectors, SQLite json/date/expression fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, NULL/collation/type-coercion/malformed-expression cases, bounded upstream runner evidence where safe, and no progress credit for shelling out to sqlite3, dolt, mysql, or external database servers.
items.reuseNotes: Keep storage codecs in sql-storage-codec-core; share only scalar expression semantics between Dolt query-diff and libsqlite execution slices, with lane adapters preserving upstream-specific diagnostics.
items.blocker: Activate for the next bounded Dolt query-diff scalar family or libsqlite SQL execution/JSON operator slice that would otherwise duplicate expression semantics lane-locally.

items.name: Archive and compression stream helpers
items.source: rclone WebDAV gzip response evidence, rclone lib/readers/gzip/archive evidence, Syncthing BEP LZ4 metadata evidence, Pandoc package needs, and PHP zlib-compatible fixture expectations
items.essentialCapability: Enables deterministic gzip/tar/archive reads and writes plus bounded HTTP response/protocol compression for sync, packaged documents, PDF benchmark data, Syncthing BEP metadata, and Git pack-adjacent workflows.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: streaming gzip/deflate wrappers, HTTP content-encoding gzip contracts when reused by VFS/WebDAV responses, tar/PAX metadata needed by archive providers, LZ4 block/frame handling for mapped protocol payloads, safe extraction paths, and bounded writer output. Out of scope: every archive format, encrypted archives, external decompressor wrappers, model/runtime compression stacks, and OS-level mount behavior.
items.testExpectation: Require an archive/compression upstream/spec denominator with mapped rclone/Syncthing/Pandoc/markerPDF/Gitoxide fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, streaming reader/writer tests, malformed/corrupt/truncated archive or compressed-frame cases, interoperability readback from local generated fixtures, and no progress credit for shelling out to tar/gzip/lz4/decompressor tools.
items.reuseNotes: Layer ZIP-specific package work separately, but share compression/path-safety primitives where practical.
items.blocker: Activate only when rclone WebDAV/archive compression, Syncthing LZ4, or Pandoc package formats need shared compression support beyond lane-local helpers and shared ZIP; missing tar/gzip/lz4 test tooling should be resolved with bounded sudo -n installs before becoming a final blocker.

items.name: Glob, ignore, and pathspec matcher core
items.source: rclone fs/filter, Syncthing ignore, Git sparse/pathspec, and esbuild entry/filter evidence in lane manifests
items.essentialCapability: Keeps include/exclude, sparse checkout, sync ignore, and review-file selection behavior consistent across tooling.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: glob syntax, include/exclude order, rooted and recursive matching, case-sensitivity controls, path normalization, and lane-specific compatibility adapters. Out of scope: filesystem watchers, live provider traversal, shell glob expansion, and arbitrary regex engines beyond mapped needs.
items.testExpectation: Create a glob/pathspec upstream/spec denominator with a mapped cross-lane fixture matrix for rclone filters, Syncthing ignores, Git pathspec/sparse rules, esbuild entry matching, and Difftastic overrides, record PHP pass/fail evidence, include malformed pattern/path cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to Git/rclone/shell glob engines.
items.reuseNotes: Prevents each lane from growing incompatible path-matching dialects; adapters can preserve upstream-specific error text.
items.blocker: none

items.name: Local provider metadata normalization core
items.source: rclone provider contract, metadata mapper, OneDrive normalization, and local memory-provider evidence plus Syncthing device/folder/config normalization evidence in lane manifests
items.essentialCapability: Normalizes local-only object, directory, timestamp, hash, case, tier, device, and folder metadata so sync decisions and review payloads behave like upstream without requiring live provider credentials.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: local provider object schemas, path and case normalization, timestamp precision, content-type/storage-tier metadata, provider IDs/parent IDs, synthetic directory metadata, device/folder config projections, and deterministic sanitized output. Out of scope: live cloud provider tests, OAuth flows, tenant-specific APIs, network remotes, secret handling, remote mutation, and cloud application wrappers.
items.testExpectation: Require a provider-normalization-specific upstream/spec denominator with mapped rclone and Syncthing local-provider/config fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, metadata/path/case/time/tier/device/folder parity, malformed/corrupt metadata and traversal cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to rclone/syncthing or contacting live cloud/service remotes.
items.reuseNotes: Reuse charset, Unicode, checksum, and glob/pathspec helpers; keep service-specific adapters local and fixture-backed so provider behavior remains testable without credentials.
items.blocker: Activate only for local-only provider normalization blockers; live-service provider coverage remains excluded by default.
